abort.already_configured: This AstralPool connection is already configured.

abort.restart_started: The Smart Next restart has started in the background. AstralPool will become temporarily unavailable for about 70–100 seconds and will reconnect automatically.
abort.maintenance_ok: The Smart Next confirmed the maintenance operation.
abort.maintenance_e2: The Smart Next returned calibration error E2: the detected value is too far from the expected value.
abort.maintenance_e3: The Smart Next returned calibration error E3: the measurement is unstable.
abort.maintenance_unavailable: The requested calibration is not available on this Smart Next configuration.
abort.maintenance_initializing: The Smart Next is still initializing and rejected the calibration operation.
abort.maintenance_first_point_ok: The Smart Next returned the first-point calibration status instead of a reset confirmation.
abort.maintenance_timeout: No calibration result was received before the timeout.
abort.maintenance_response_not_cleared: The previous calibration result could not be cleared.
abort.maintenance_unsupported: This maintenance procedure is not supported.
abort.maintenance_communication_failed: Communication with the Smart Next failed during the maintenance procedure.
abort.maintenance_failed: The Smart Next maintenance procedure failed.
abort.ph_standard_ok: Two-point pH calibration completed successfully and the installation was restored.
abort.orp_ok: 470 mV Redox / ORP calibration completed successfully and the installation was restored.
abort.ph_reset_ok: The factory pH calibration was restored successfully.
abort.orp_reset_ok: The factory Redox / ORP calibration was restored successfully.

error.confirmation_required: Confirm the requested step before continuing.
error.calibration_communication_failed: Communication with the Smart Next failed during calibration. Keep the installation in a safe state and retry only after communication is restored.
error.calibration_e2: E2 — the detected value is too far from the expected calibration value.
error.calibration_e3: E3 — the measurement is unstable. Clean the probe, gently agitate it in the reference solution and wait for a stable reading before retrying.
error.calibration_unavailable: Calibration unavailable (IR 0x22 = 4). Check the current Smart Next state and retry.
error.calibration_initializing: The sensor is still initializing (IR 0x22 = 5). Wait until it is ready before retrying.
error.calibration_mode_lost: Calibration mode ended before a usable result was captured.
error.calibration_timeout: No calibration response was received before the timeout.
error.calibration_failed: The Smart Next returned an unexpected calibration result.
error.calibration_mode_not_active: Calibration mode 0x201 could not be activated.
error.treatment_not_halted: The Smart Next did not confirm that treatment and dosing were halted after entering calibration mode.
error.calibration_response_not_cleared: IR 0x22 could not be cleared while calibration mode was active.
error.electrolysis_not_stopped: Electrolysis could not be verified fully stopped. The hydraulic procedure is blocked.
error.electrolysis_safety_lost: Electrolysis is no longer confirmed stopped. Production must remain at 0 % until the installation is safely restored.
error.ph_pump_not_stopped: The real pH dosing-pump output is not 0 %. Do not open the hydraulic circuit or remove a probe.
error.stabilization_wait: The mandatory 60-second stabilization period has not finished yet. Wait until the full minute has elapsed.
error.measurement_not_confirmed_stable: After at least 60 seconds, confirm that the displayed measurement is stable before calibration.
error.ph_first_point_missing: The Smart Next no longer reports the accepted pH 7 first point. Restart the standard pH calibration from pH 7.
error.calibration_mode_rearm_failed: Calibration mode 0x201 could not be activated for the requested calibration attempt. Electrolysis remains forced to 0 %.
error.calibration_mode_rearm_too_slow: Calibration mode 0x201 could not be confirmed within the safety window. Electrolysis remains forced to 0 %.
error.calibration_mode_not_released: Calibration mode 0x201 could not be released before normal operation was restored.
error.flow_not_restored: Normal water flow through the electrolyzer has not been confirmed. Production remains at 0 %; correct the valves/circulation and retry the final restoration step.

maintenance.title: Smart Next maintenance
maintenance.description: Choose a guided maintenance procedure. Only procedures supported by the detected Smart Next hardware are shown.

maintenance_confirm.title: Confirm maintenance procedure
maintenance_confirm.description: The selected operation writes directly to the Smart Next over local Modbus. Confirm only if you want to execute the selected procedure now.

data.confirm: I understand and want to execute this procedure

calibrate_sensor.title: Calibrate a Smart Next sensor
calibrate_sensor.description: Choose a hardware-validated calibration procedure. Salinity remains available only through the raw Calibration TEST entities until its sequence is validated.

calibrate_ph.title: pH calibration
calibrate_ph.description: Fast calibration corrects the installed probe from a trusted reference measurement. Standard calibration removes the probe and uses pH 7 then pH 4 reference solutions.

calibrate_ph_fast.title: pH — Fast calibration
calibrate_ph_fast.description: Leave the pH probe installed and keep normal circulation running. Current Smart Next pH: {current_ph}. Enter a trusted reference pH. Home Assistant activates 0x201, clears IR 0x22 with 0x203, writes reference ×100 to HR 0x22, triggers 0x50F and displays the result.

calibrate_ph_standard_prepare.title: pH Standard — Software safety
calibrate_ph_standard_prepare.description: Keep filtration RUNNING and all valves in their NORMAL position. Home Assistant saves the current controller state, forces pH Pump Stop ON as an additional safeguard, keeps flow supervision active, disables electrolysis overrides, forces electrolysis production to 0 %, and verifies production/current/running are zero. Pump Stop is not treated as proof that the dosing pump is stopped: the real pH pump output is checked after filtration is stopped. Calibration mode 0x201 is not started yet.

data.confirm: Normal circulation is active; secure the installation

calibrate_ph_standard_filtration_off.title: pH Standard — Preparation 1/6 · Stop filtration
calibrate_ph_standard_filtration_off.description: Switch OFF the filtration pump and physically verify that it has stopped. When you validate, Home Assistant also requires the real pH dosing-pump output (IR 0x58) to be 0 % before allowing the hydraulic circuit to be opened.

data.filtration_off: Filtration is OFF and I have physically checked that the pump is stopped

calibrate_ph_standard_bypass_open.title: pH Standard — Preparation 2/6 · Open bypass
calibrate_ph_standard_bypass_open.description: Fully OPEN the electrolyzer bypass valve, then validate.

data.bypass_open: The electrolyzer bypass valve is OPEN

calibrate_ph_standard_inlet_closed.title: pH Standard — Preparation 3/6 · Close inlet valve
calibrate_ph_standard_inlet_closed.description: CLOSE the valve upstream of the electrolyzer, on the probe/inlet side, then validate.

calibrate_ph_standard_outlet_closed.title: pH Standard — Preparation 4/6 · Close outlet valve
calibrate_ph_standard_outlet_closed.description: CLOSE the valve downstream of the electrolyzer, at the electrolyzer outlet. The electrolyzer section is now isolated between the two closed valves.

calibrate_ph_standard_probe_loosened.title: pH Standard — Preparation 5/6 · Loosen pH probe
calibrate_ph_standard_probe_loosened.description: Slightly unscrew the pH probe you intend to remove. Do not remove it completely yet.

data.probe_loosened: The pH probe is slightly loosened but still in place

calibrate_ph_standard_drain_pulse.title: pH Standard — Preparation 6/6 · Lower water level
calibrate_ph_standard_drain_pulse.description: Very slightly OPEN the downstream/outlet valve for no more than 2 seconds so a small amount of air enters the isolated section and the water level drops, then CLOSE it immediately. Never leave it open for more than 2 seconds. Validate only after the outlet valve is CLOSED again. Calibration mode is still OFF at this stage.

data.drain_done: I opened the outlet valve for at most 2 seconds and it is CLOSED again

calibrate_ph_standard_ph7_immerse.title: pH Standard — pH 7 · Immerse probe
calibrate_ph_standard_ph7_immerse.description: Now fully remove the pH probe, rinse/clean it, immerse it in fresh pH 7 reference solution and gently agitate it. Validate only once the probe is fully immersed; this starts the mandatory 60-second stabilization timer.

data.immersed: The clean pH probe is fully immersed in pH 7 solution

calibrate_ph_standard_ph7.title: pH Standard — Calibration 1/2 · pH 7
calibrate_ph_standard_ph7.description: The probe must remain in the pH 7 solution for at least 60 seconds. Remaining minimum time: {remaining} s. Current reading: {current_ph}. After the full minute, confirm the value is stable. Home Assistant then activates 0x201, verifies treatment halted, temporarily disables flow supervision, clears IR 0x22 with 0x203 and triggers pH 7 calibration 0x50D. IR 0x22 = 16 confirms the first point and 0x201 remains active for pH 4.

data.stable: At least 60 seconds have elapsed and the pH reading is stable

calibrate_ph_standard_ph4_immerse.title: pH Standard — pH 4 · Immerse probe
calibrate_ph_standard_ph4_immerse.description: Rinse/clean the probe, immerse it in fresh pH 4 reference solution and gently agitate it. The accepted pH 7 session remains active. Validate once fully immersed to start a new mandatory 60-second stabilization timer.

data.immersed: The clean pH probe is fully immersed in pH 4 solution

calibrate_ph_standard_ph4.title: pH Standard — Calibration 2/2 · pH 4
calibrate_ph_standard_ph4.description: Keep the probe in pH 4 solution for at least 60 seconds. Remaining minimum time: {remaining} s. Current reading: {current_ph}. After the full minute, confirm the value is stable to trigger 0x50E. IR 0x22 = 1 confirms success and the Smart Next normally releases 0x201. AstralPool does NOT re-enter calibration mode after that terminal result; instead it immediately restores flow supervision, verifies the pH pump output is 0 %, and keeps electrolysis forced to 0 %.

data.stable: At least 60 seconds have elapsed and the pH reading is stable

calibrate_ph_standard_error.title: pH Standard — Calibration error
calibrate_ph_standard_error.description: Result: {error}. A terminal error can release 0x201. AstralPool does not automatically re-enter calibration mode: it restores flow supervision as quickly as possible and keeps electrolysis forced to 0 %. Choose Retry to start a fresh calibration session, or safely restore the installation.

calibrate_ph_standard_next_sensor.title: pH calibration complete — Calibrate ORP too?
calibrate_ph_standard_next_sensor.description: The pH two-point calibration succeeded. Flow supervision has already been restored and electrolysis remains forced to 0 %. Because the electrolyzer section is still isolated, you can calibrate Redox / ORP now without repeating the full hydraulic preparation, or finish and restore the installation.

calibrate_ph_standard_chain_orp.title: Continue with ORP — Reinstall pH probe
calibrate_ph_standard_chain_orp.description: Before removing the ORP probe, rinse the calibrated pH probe if needed, reinstall it completely and tighten it correctly. Keep filtration OFF, both isolation valves CLOSED and the bypass OPEN.

data.ph_reinstalled: The calibrated pH probe is reinstalled and tightened

calibrate_ph_standard_chain_orp_immerse.title: Continue with ORP — Immerse at 470 mV
calibrate_ph_standard_chain_orp_immerse.description: Slightly loosen then remove the ORP probe, clean it and immerse it in fresh 470 mV reference solution at approximately 25 °C. Validate once fully immersed to start the mandatory 60-second stabilization timer.

data.orp_immersed: The clean ORP probe is fully immersed in 470 mV solution

calibrate_ph_standard_restore.title: pH Standard — Restoration 1/5 · Reinstall probe
calibrate_ph_standard_restore.description: Rinse the pH probe if necessary, reinstall it fully and tighten it correctly. Flow supervision has already been restored; filtration remains OFF, both isolation valves remain CLOSED and electrolysis remains forced to 0 %.

data.probe_installed: The pH probe is fully reinstalled and tightened

calibrate_ph_standard_restore_inlet.title: pH Standard — Restoration 2/5 · Open inlet valve
calibrate_ph_standard_restore_inlet.description: With filtration still OFF and bypass still OPEN, fully OPEN the upstream/inlet valve.

calibrate_ph_standard_restore_outlet.title: pH Standard — Restoration 3/5 · Open outlet valve
calibrate_ph_standard_restore_outlet.description: Fully OPEN the downstream/outlet valve. Both isolation valves must now be open.

calibrate_ph_standard_restore_bypass.title: pH Standard — Restoration 4/5 · Close bypass
calibrate_ph_standard_restore_bypass.description: CLOSE the electrolyzer bypass valve so the normal hydraulic path passes through the electrolyzer again.

data.bypass_closed: The bypass valve is CLOSED and the hydraulic path is normal

calibrate_ph_standard_restore_filtration.title: pH Standard — Restoration 5/5 · Restart filtration
calibrate_ph_standard_restore_filtration.description: Switch filtration back ON and verify real circulation through the electrolyzer. Home Assistant then verifies Smart Next flow and only afterwards restores the previous electrolysis settings and the original Pump Stop configuration.

data.filtration_on: Filtration is ON and circulation through the electrolyzer is confirmed

calibrate_orp_prepare.title: Redox / ORP — Software safety
calibrate_orp_prepare.description: Keep filtration RUNNING and all valves in their NORMAL position. Home Assistant saves the controller state, forces pH Pump Stop ON as an additional safeguard, keeps flow supervision active, disables electrolysis overrides, forces electrolysis to 0 %, and verifies it is stopped. Calibration mode 0x201 is not started yet.

data.confirm: Normal circulation is active; secure the installation

calibrate_orp_filtration_off.title: Redox / ORP — Preparation 1/6 · Stop filtration
calibrate_orp_filtration_off.description: Switch OFF the filtration pump and physically verify that it has stopped. When validated, Home Assistant also requires the real pH dosing-pump output (IR 0x58) to be 0 % before allowing the hydraulic circuit to be opened.

data.filtration_off: Filtration is OFF and I have physically checked that the pump is stopped

calibrate_orp_bypass_open.title: Redox / ORP — Preparation 2/6 · Open bypass
calibrate_orp_bypass_open.description: Fully OPEN the electrolyzer bypass valve.

data.bypass_open: The electrolyzer bypass valve is OPEN

calibrate_orp_inlet_closed.title: Redox / ORP — Preparation 3/6 · Close inlet valve
calibrate_orp_inlet_closed.description: CLOSE the upstream/inlet valve on the probe side.

calibrate_orp_outlet_closed.title: Redox / ORP — Preparation 4/6 · Close outlet valve
calibrate_orp_outlet_closed.description: CLOSE the downstream/outlet valve. The electrolyzer section is now isolated.

calibrate_orp_probe_loosened.title: Redox / ORP — Preparation 5/6 · Loosen ORP probe
calibrate_orp_probe_loosened.description: Slightly unscrew the ORP probe. Do not remove it completely yet.

data.probe_loosened: The ORP probe is slightly loosened but still in place

calibrate_orp_drain_pulse.title: Redox / ORP — Preparation 6/6 · Lower water level
calibrate_orp_drain_pulse.description: Very slightly OPEN the downstream/outlet valve for no more than 2 seconds so a little air enters and the water level drops, then CLOSE it immediately. Never leave it open for more than 2 seconds. Calibration mode is still OFF at this stage.

data.drain_done: I opened the outlet valve for at most 2 seconds and it is CLOSED again

calibrate_orp_immerse.title: Redox / ORP — Immerse probe at 470 mV
calibrate_orp_immerse.description: Fully remove and clean the ORP probe. Immerse it in fresh 470 mV reference solution at approximately 25 °C and gently agitate it. Validate once fully immersed to start the mandatory 60-second stabilization timer.

data.immersed: The clean ORP probe is fully immersed in 470 mV solution

calibrate_orp_470.title: Redox / ORP — Calibration at 470 mV
calibrate_orp_470.description: Keep the probe immersed for at least 60 seconds. Remaining minimum time: {remaining} s. Current reading: {current_orp} mV. After the full minute, confirm the measurement is stable. Home Assistant then activates 0x201, verifies treatment halted, temporarily disables flow supervision, clears IR 0x22 with 0x203 and triggers 0x80F. IR 0x22 = 1 means success. After any terminal result, AstralPool does NOT re-enter 0x201; it immediately restores flow supervision, verifies the pH pump output is 0 %, and keeps electrolysis forced to 0 %.

data.stable: At least 60 seconds have elapsed and the ORP reading is stable

calibrate_orp_error.title: Redox / ORP — Calibration error
calibrate_orp_error.description: Result: {error}. A terminal error can release 0x201. AstralPool does not automatically re-enter calibration mode: flow supervision is restored as quickly as possible and electrolysis remains forced to 0 %. Retry at 470 mV or safely restore the installation.

calibrate_orp_next_sensor.title: ORP calibration complete — Calibrate pH too?
calibrate_orp_next_sensor.description: The 470 mV ORP calibration succeeded. Flow supervision has already been restored and electrolysis remains forced to 0 %. Because the electrolyzer section is still isolated, you can calibrate pH now without repeating the full hydraulic preparation, or finish and restore the installation.

calibrate_orp_chain_ph.title: Continue with pH — Reinstall ORP probe
calibrate_orp_chain_ph.description: Before removing the pH probe, rinse the calibrated ORP probe if needed, reinstall it completely and tighten it correctly. Keep filtration OFF, both isolation valves CLOSED and the bypass OPEN.

data.orp_reinstalled: The calibrated ORP probe is reinstalled and tightened

calibrate_orp_chain_ph7_immerse.title: Continue with pH — Immerse in pH 7
calibrate_orp_chain_ph7_immerse.description: Slightly loosen then remove the pH probe, clean it and immerse it in fresh pH 7 reference solution. Validate once fully immersed to start the mandatory 60-second stabilization timer. The pH 4 point will follow after pH 7 is accepted.

data.ph_immersed: The clean pH probe is fully immersed in pH 7 solution

calibrate_orp_restore.title: Redox / ORP — Restoration 1/5 · Reinstall probe
calibrate_orp_restore.description: Rinse the ORP probe if necessary, reinstall it fully and tighten it correctly. Flow supervision has already been restored; filtration remains OFF, both isolation valves remain CLOSED and electrolysis remains forced to 0 %.

data.probe_installed: The ORP probe is fully reinstalled and tightened

calibrate_orp_restore_inlet.title: Redox / ORP — Restoration 2/5 · Open inlet valve
calibrate_orp_restore_inlet.description: With filtration OFF and bypass OPEN, fully OPEN the upstream/inlet valve.

calibrate_orp_restore_outlet.title: Redox / ORP — Restoration 3/5 · Open outlet valve

calibrate_orp_restore_bypass.title: Redox / ORP — Restoration 4/5 · Close bypass
calibrate_orp_restore_bypass.description: CLOSE the electrolyzer bypass valve so the normal hydraulic path passes through the electrolyzer again.

data.bypass_closed: The bypass valve is CLOSED and the hydraulic path is normal

calibrate_orp_restore_filtration.title: Redox / ORP — Restoration 5/5 · Restart filtration
calibrate_orp_restore_filtration.description: Switch filtration back ON and verify real circulation through the electrolyzer. Home Assistant then verifies Smart Next flow and only afterwards restores the previous electrolysis settings and original Pump Stop configuration.

data.filtration_on: Filtration is ON and circulation through the electrolyzer is confirmed

restore_calibration.title: Restore factory calibration
restore_calibration.description: Choose a hardware-validated sensor calibration reset.

restore_ph_calibration.title: Restore factory pH calibration
restore_ph_calibration.description: Keep the probe installed and normal circulation active. Home Assistant performs the validated sequence 0x201 ON → 0x203 → IR 0x22 = 0 → pH reset 0x50C. IR 0x22 = 1 confirms success and the Smart Next normally releases 0x201 automatically.

data.confirm: Restore the factory pH calibration now

restore_orp_calibration.title: Restore factory Redox / ORP calibration
restore_orp_calibration.description: Keep the probe installed and normal circulation active. Home Assistant performs the validated sequence 0x201 ON → 0x203 → IR 0x22 = 0 → ORP reset 0x80C. IR 0x22 = 1 confirms success and the Smart Next normally releases 0x201 automatically.

data.confirm: Restore the factory Redox / ORP calibration now

calibrate_temperature.title: Temperature calibration
calibrate_temperature.description: Enter the trusted reference water temperature. The validated sequence writes reference ×10 to HR 0x22, triggers 0xB0F and waits 5 seconds.

alarm_count_cooling_pipe_too_high.name: Counters · cooling pipe temperature too high
